cases.name: Phase 0 Baseline State Discovery & Queue Rebuild
cases.prompt: Inspect this repository baseline state, remotes, and open issues to select the next actionable issue.
expected_actions: Inspects git branches, commit SHA, remote URLs, and working tree cleanliness
Rebuilds actionable queue using priority hierarchy P0 to P3
Selects exactly one unblocked candidate issue

cases.name: Issue Execution Contract & TDD RED-to-GREEN
cases.prompt: Deliver issue #42: Session Invalidation Race Condition using TDD.
expected_actions: Synthesizes formal Issue Execution Contract before code edits
Writes failing RED test proving the race condition
Creates atomic commits with conventional commit messages

cases.name: Pre-PR Verification & Independent Review Gate
cases.prompt: Run pre-PR verification and conduct independent code review on the implementation.
expected_actions: Executes fresh unit, lint, typecheck, and build commands
Conducts independent diff review with zero blocking findings
Prepares comprehensive Pull Request linked to issue

cases.name: Authorized Merge, Post-Merge Health Check & Delivery Receipt
cases.prompt: Verify CI passes, merge PR #108 autonomously, check default branch health, and close issue #42.
expected_actions: Verifies remote CI checks pass cleanly
Merges PR #108 following repository merge policy without bypassing protection
Verifies default branch health at merge SHA
Closes issue #42 and records durable Delivery Receipt comment
